grammar.title: 程度补语“得很”
grammar.scene: How would you say the weather is extremely good or someone is very sad?
grammar.structure: 形容词 / 状态动词 + 得很
grammar.explanation: “得很”放在形容词或状态动词后，表示程度很高，多用于口语。

examples.hanzi: 现在天气好得很。
examples.english: The weather is extremely good now.

examples.hanzi: 房间里面热得很。
examples.english: It is extremely hot inside the room.

examples.hanzi: 我觉得爬山累得很。
examples.english: I think mountain climbing is extremely tiring.

examples.hanzi: 听说手机丢了，他着急得很。
examples.english: He was terribly anxious when he heard the phone was lost.

examples.hanzi: 她收到朋友的照片，高兴得很。
examples.english: She was extremely happy to receive her friend’s photos.

grammar.title: 量词重叠
grammar.scene: How would you say every photo looks good or every student has prepared?
grammar.structure: 量词 + 量词 + 都 + 谓语
grammar.explanation: 量词重叠强调范围内的每一个成员都有同样的特点，后面常用“都”。

examples.hanzi: 这些照片张张都非常好看。
examples.english: Every one of these photos looks great.

examples.hanzi: 这些苹果个个都很大。
examples.english: Every one of these apples is large.

examples.hanzi: 我们班的学生人人都喜欢拍照。
examples.english: Every student in our class likes taking photos.

examples.hanzi: 这几家宾馆家家都很干净。
examples.english: Every one of these hotels is clean.

examples.hanzi: 这个星期天天都下雨。
examples.english: It rained every day this week.

grammar.title: 存现句（3）
grammar.scene: How would you describe people, cars, or birds appearing from a place or direction?
grammar.structure: 处所词语 + 动词 + 趋向/结果补语 + 了 + 数量短语 + 人/物
grammar.explanation: 用来说明某处出现或消失了人或事物，先说地点，再说变化和新出现的对象。

examples.hanzi: 后边走过去两个人。
examples.english: Two people walked past in the back.

examples.hanzi: 前面开过来很多车。
examples.english: Many cars are coming from the front.

examples.hanzi: 楼上下来了几个人。
examples.english: Several people came downstairs.

examples.hanzi: 树上飞来了几只鸟。
examples.english: Several birds flew into the tree.

examples.hanzi: 教室里走进来一位新老师。
examples.english: A new teacher walked into the classroom.

grammar.title: “……了……就……”
grammar.scene: How would you connect two actions when the second follows immediately after the first?
grammar.structure: 动词₁ + 了 + 宾语₁ + 就 + 动词₂ + 宾语₂
grammar.explanation: 表示两个动作紧接着发生；如果第二个动作也已经完成，句尾可以再用“了”。

examples.hanzi: 你听完了音乐会就来我家吃饭。
examples.english: Come to my home for dinner after the concert.

examples.hanzi: 我吃了早饭就去学校了。
examples.english: I went to school right after breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 昨天我们下了课就回家了。
examples.english: Yesterday we went home as soon as class ended.

examples.hanzi: 她拍完了照片就发给朋友。
examples.english: She sent the photos to her friend right after taking them.

examples.hanzi: 我们爬了山就去饭馆吃饭。
examples.english: We went to a restaurant after climbing the mountain.

texts.title: 今天终于晴了
texts.setting: 在街上，白家月和李文边散步边聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这个星期总是阴天，今天终于晴了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī zǒngshì yīntiān, jīntiān zhōngyú qíng le.
lines.english: It was always overcast this week; it is finally sunny today.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 现在天气好得很！我们去爬山怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài tiānqì hǎo de hěn! Wǒmen qù pá shān zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: The weather is wonderful right now! How about we go mountain climbing?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 好啊！又能锻炼身体，又能照好看的照片。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Yòu néng duànliàn shēntǐ, yòu néng zhào hǎokàn de zhàopiàn.
lines.english: Great! We can both exercise and take nice photos.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 那我带点儿水和吃的，咱们现在就去？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ dài diǎnr shuǐ hé chī de, zánmen xiànzài jiù qù?
lines.english: Then I will bring some water and snacks. Shall we go right now?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我回去穿上运动鞋，拿上大衣。要不要叫一雪姐一起去？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huíqù chuānshang yùndòngxié, náshang dàyī. Yào bu yào jiào Yīxuě jiě yìqǐ qù?
lines.english: I will go back to put on sneakers and grab my coat. Should we ask Sister Yixue to come along?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 好主意。给她打个电话吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyi. Gěi tā dǎ gè diànhuà ba.
lines.english: Good idea. Give her a call.

texts.title: 这样的照片才好看
texts.setting: 在出租车上，王一雪和白家月在聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这些照片是谁给您照的？张张都非常好看。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì shéi gěi nín zhào de? Zhāngzhāng dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
lines.english: Who took these photos for you? Every single one looks great.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 一飞。她对拍照一直很感兴趣，经常给我照相。
lines.pinyin: Yīfēi. Tā duì pāizhào yìzhí hěn gǎn xìngqù, jīngcháng gěi wǒ zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: Yifei. She has always been very interested in photography and often takes pictures of me.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我喜欢您大笑的这张，看起来很漂亮。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan nín dà xiào de zhè zhāng, kàn qǐlai hěn piàoliang.
lines.english: I like this one where you are laughing out loud; you look very beautiful.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我觉得这张有点儿难看，那时候我不知道她在给我照相。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè zhāng yǒudiǎnr nánkàn, nà shíhou wǒ bù zhīdào tā zài gěi wǒ zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: I think this one is a bit unflattering; I did not know she was taking a picture of me then.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这样的照片才好看。我也喜欢拍照，爬山的时候我给您照几张照片吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de zhàopiàn cái hǎokàn. Wǒ yě xǐhuan pāizhào, pá shān de shíhou wǒ gěi nín zhào jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn ba.
lines.english: Photos like these are the best. I like taking pictures too; let me take a few for you while climbing the mountain.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好，我可以比较一下你们两个谁的水平高。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ kěyǐ bǐjiào yíxià nǐmen liǎng gè shéi de shuǐpíng gāo.
lines.english: Alright, then I can compare whose photography skills are better between the two of you.

texts.title: 在山上拍照
texts.setting: 在山上，王一雪和白家月边走边聊。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 家月，这里挺漂亮的，咱们在这里拍照吧。
lines.pinyin: Jiāyuè, zhèlǐ tǐng piàoliang de, zánmen zài zhèlǐ pāizhào ba.
lines.english: Jiayue, it is quite beautiful here. Let us take photos here.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这边没有太阳，咱们去那边吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhèbiān méiyǒu tàiyáng, zánmen qù nàbiān ba.
lines.english: There is no sunlight over here; let us head over there.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好。你觉得我站在这些树中间怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Nǐ juéde wǒ zhàn zài zhèxiē shù zhōngjiān zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Sure. What do you think if I stand among these trees?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 挺好的。等一下，后边走过去两个人。
lines.pinyin: Tǐng hǎo de. Děng yíxià, hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng gè rén.
lines.english: Pretty good. Wait a second, two people are walking past in the back.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我准备好了，你照的时候告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǔnbèi hǎo le, nǐ zhào de shíhou gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: I am ready. Tell me when you take it.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 你不用看着我，想干什么都可以。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng kànzhe wǒ, xiǎng gàn shénme dōu kěyǐ.
lines.english: You do not need to look at me; just do whatever you like.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 树上飞来了几只鸟，我就看着它们吧。
lines.pinyin: Shù shang fēilái le jǐ zhī niǎo, wǒ jiù kànzhe tāmen ba.
lines.english: A few birds just flew into the tree; I will just look at them.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 啊，手机没电了。
lines.pinyin: À, shǒujī méi diàn le.
lines.english: Oh no, my phone battery is dead.

texts.title: 音乐会以后来我家
texts.author: 王一雪
texts.setting: 在咖啡厅里，王一雪给白家月发短信。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 家月，我收到了你的那封邮件，也看到了你给我照的照片，张张都很漂亮。我已经告诉了一飞，你的拍照水平比她高，她难过得很，哈哈。不知道你对中国的音乐有没有兴趣？我送你一张明天下午音乐会的门票。音乐会七点多结束，你听完了音乐会就来我家吃饭，尝尝我做的中国菜。你觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Jiāyuè, wǒ shōudào le nǐ de nà fēng yóujiàn, yě kàndào le nǐ gěi wǒ zhào de zhàopiàn, zhāngzhāng dōu hěn piàoliang. Wǒ yǐjīng gàosu le Yīfēi, nǐ de pāizhào shuǐpíng bǐ tā gāo, tā nánguò de hěn, hāhā. Bù zhīdào nǐ duì Zhōngguó de yīnyuè yǒu méiyǒu xìngqù? Wǒ sòng nǐ yì zhāng míngtiān xiàwǔ yīnyuèhuì de ménpiào. Yīnyuèhuì qī diǎn duō jiéshù, nǐ tīngwán le yīnyuèhuì jiù lái wǒ jiā chī fàn, chángchang wǒ zuò de Zhōngguó cài. Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Jiayue, I received your email and saw the photos you took of me. Every one is beautiful. I told Yifei that your photography skills are better than hers, and she is terribly sad, haha. Are you interested in Chinese music? I am giving you a ticket to tomorrow afternoon’s concert. The concert ends after seven. Come to my home for dinner after it finishes and try the Chinese dishes I make. What do you think?

instructions.required: 完成照片项目的当次准备卡；最终口头作品在课堂完成。
instructions.optional: 不需要上传录音。A、B 保存的素材会用于 C 的课堂展示。
instructions.aiPolicy: 先独立选择照片和组织内容，再使用工具检查语言。

A.label: 照片项目 · 第1步
A.goal: 选择一种喜欢的休闲活动，准备照片或拍摄计划。
A.suggested_mix: 课后完成活动与照片计划卡；下次课两人交换建议。

B.label: 照片项目 · 第2步
B.goal: 选择最满意的照片并整理评价理由。
B.suggested_mix: 完成照片评价卡；课堂采用小组互评和抽样分享。

C.label: 课堂最终项目 · 我最满意的照片
C.goal: 选择一张或几张最满意的照片，说明为什么拍得好。
C.suggested_mix: 不上传录音；课堂先小组彩排，再抽样展示。

A.projectStage: 照片项目 1/3 · 选择活动
A.prompt_cn: 你最喜欢在哪儿、和谁一起做什么休闲活动？你有相关照片吗？
A.prompt_en: Choose a free-time activity you enjoy. Where and with whom do you usually do it? Do you already have a related photo?
A.answerPlaceholder: 我喜欢……。我常常在……和……一起……。

A.projectStage: 照片项目 1/3 · 保存到最终展示
A.prompt_cn: 准备一张已有照片，或者写下你想拍的画面：地点、人物、活动和要准备的东西。
A.prompt_en: Choose one existing photo or plan a photo you want to take. Note the place, people, activity and materials.
A.answerPlaceholder:
地点：……
人物：……
活动：……
我要准备：……

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 写3—4句话，说明地点、人物、活动和准备。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 写5句话，加入天气、原因和“得很”。

A.prompt_en: Prepare the material below for the next class.
presentationPlan: Bring one clear photo of a free-time activity, or a simple plan for a photo you want to take.
Be ready to answer: Where was it? Who was there? What were you doing?
Use at least three lesson words.
You may discuss it with a partner. No audio upload is required.
A.classroomNote: Bring the photo or plan to class. You do not need to upload an audio recording.

B.projectStage: 照片项目 2/3 · 发现好照片
B.prompt_cn: 从你的照片中选一张最满意的。照片里有什么？你为什么喜欢它？
B.prompt_en: Choose one photo you are most satisfied with. What can we see, and why do you like it?
B.answerPlaceholder: 我最满意……。照片里……。我喜欢它，因为……。

B.projectStage: 照片项目 2/3 · 保存展示理由
B.prompt_cn: 完成照片评价卡：写出两个优点和一个可以改进的地方。
B.prompt_en: Complete a photo review card: two strengths and one possible improvement.
B.answerPlaceholder:
优点1：……
优点2：……
可以改进：……
所以我最满意……

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 从词语和句框中选择，完成3句话。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 写4句话，说明两个优点并使用“才”或“张张都”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较两张照片，使用“比较、水平、得很”等表达。

B.prompt_cn: Classroom Preparation: Why This Photo Works
B.prompt_en: Prepare to explain why your selected photo works well.
presentationPlan: Bring one to three photos you are satisfied with.
Be ready to identify the subject, action, expression, light or background.
Explain at least two reasons why the photo works well.
You may ask a partner for one short comment. No audio upload is required.
B.classroomNote: Save the photos for the final in-class presentation.

C.projectStage: 照片项目 3/3 · 组织展示
C.prompt_cn: 你准备展示一张还是几张照片？你希望同学先看到什么、最后记住什么？
C.prompt_en: Will you present one photo or several photos? What should the class notice first, and what should they remember?
C.answerPlaceholder: 我准备展示……张照片。请大家先看……。我希望大家记住……。

C.projectStage: 课堂大作业 · 我最满意的照片
C.prompt_cn: 选择一张或几张你最满意的照片，准备说明为什么拍得好。
C.prompt_en: Choose one or several photos you are most satisfied with and prepare to explain why they were taken well.
C.answerPlaceholder:
这是我最满意的照片。
照片里……。
我觉得它拍得好，因为……。
我还想说……。

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 展示1张照片，用4个句框说清人物、地点、活动和一个优点。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 展示1—3张照片，使用至少6个本课词和1个本课结构，说明两个拍得好的理由。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 比较几张照片，讲拍摄过程，并使用至少2个本课结构。

C.projectStage: 最终回收 · My Best Photo
C.prompt_en: Choose one or several photos you are most satisfied with and explain why they were taken well.
presentationPlan: Bring one to three photos you are most satisfied with. They may show your free-time activity, friends, travel or daily life.
Answer: What is in the photo? When and where was it taken? What happened? Why do you think it was taken well?
Use at least six lesson words and at least one structure such as 得很, 张张都, a place-appearance sentence, or ……了……就……。
Speak for 1–2 minutes. You may prepare in a small group, but every student must explain at least one photo or one reason.
C.classroomNote: Present mainly in class. You do not need to upload an audio recording.

recommendationRules.then: 重做对应五步预习并复习错词。
选择一张照片，用本课词语和结构重新说明。
